Artist

JUNHEE
Park Junhee
b. 1994
📍 South Jeolla
JUNHEE debuted in 2017 as a member and leader of the K-pop group A.C.E.
In 2025, he founded his own label and launched his solo career.
In 2021, he played the lead role in the BL web series “Tinted With You”. He also openly stated that he is not gay himself.
